tweenHpFill.note: used for every HP change except death's hard-cut: damage, auto-potion/heal, passive Recovering regen, revive potion — none of these have a dedicated audio cue of their own beyond run.hpLow/run.autoPotionUsed which animate the toast, not the bar

hardCutHpFill.note: death only (motion-direction §6.3 point 1) — bar snaps to scaleX(0) with no drain animation

setHpFillReduced.note: reduced-motion variant for tweenHpFill/hardCutHpFill alike — same end state, no intermediate motion

tweenHpEdgeMarker.note: P2-H42/V-39: .hp-fill-edge-marker's counterpart to tweenHpFill, added when the client's first pass (P2-X42) moved the marker with a `left` transition instead — rejected per motion-direction §2's transform/opacity-only budget (same layout-reflow cost as the `width` the fill itself avoids). Always fired on the same event as tweenHpFill, same duration/easing, so both nodes move in lockstep.

hardCutHpEdgeMarker.note: death only, mirrors hardCutHpFill — marker snaps to translateX(0-based) with no drain

setHpEdgeMarkerReduced.note: reduced-motion variant for tweenHpEdgeMarker/hardCutHpEdgeMarker alike, and the function for a fresh mount / instant update with no previous ratio to tween from
